scope: Retry-safe edit, delete and report behavior for CHAT-MESSAGE-ACTIONS. The shared ViewModel uses one mutation lock across edit, delete and report, preserves the exact failed request and actor, revalidates the actor before applying an edit completion, removes and republishes any stale optimistic edit when the actor changes, and exposes an explicit retry. Web/iOS PostgREST and Android use authenticated v2 edit/delete RPCs with atomic mutation receipts while the v1 Android v32 compatibility path remains unchanged.

validation.iosAffected: bash ./gradlew :feature:chat:iosX64Test with the nine changed mutation test methods selected explicitly
validation.remoteProbe: node scripts/chat-message-mutation-remote-probe.mjs with private DB URL and CA file inputs

findings: Edit completion did not revalidate the exact actor.
Web and iOS rollback fault injectors recognized only v1 edit/delete RPC names.
Edit could overlap delete or report.

closedFindings: Web and iOS fault injectors recognize both v1 and v2, with product contracts bound to v2.
Edit, delete and report share one cross-action mutation lock.
Edit completion revalidates the exact actor and removes the stale overlay internally.
remediationReview.remainingFinding: The actor-mismatch path removed the stale overlay map entry but did not republish backend messages, so the previous actor's optimistic text could remain visible.

reviewHistory.finalRemediation: Product f74af79b republishes backend messages immediately after removing the stale optimistic edit; the regression test asserts original text and non-pending state after both late success and late failure.

provenance.difference: The 84-test Web and nine-test iOS affected baselines ran on b487a484. a5133995 changed only two capability-matrix source hashes. f74af79b adds the reviewer-driven actor-replacement republish fix, its executable regression assertions and a fail-closed source contract. The exact new test passed on Web and is recorded for iOS; Android compilation, 773 fast contracts and 22 capability tests passed on f74af79b. Unaffected baseline matrices were not repeated solely for SHA changes.

limits: The first broad iOS run remains failed evidence: all 52 ChatViewModel tests passed, while one unrelated historical inbox pagination repository test exhausted its virtual five-second timeout (29 of 30 repository tests passed). All nine changed mutation methods passed in the accepted focal rerun.

The full logical backup cannot be called generally restorable into vanilla PostgreSQL because the managed Supabase roles and extensions are absent there. The selective affected-object restore drill passed.
The remote database probe applied the migration only inside an outer transaction and rolled it back. Persistent deployment follows candidate promotion and its guarded release procedure.
This focal unit does not declare global SCR-CHAT acceptance or acceptance of actions owned by other subflows.
